title: Support that knows every account
description: Triage the queue, crack hard cases in the product itself, and resolve with proof. It's how we run our own support.
introduction: A good support answer needs the helpdesk, the CRM, billing, the docs, and sometimes the product itself, as the customer sees it. That's five tabs before you've typed a word.
Strawberry checks all of them in the browser, drafts the reply, and keeps the evidence next to it. We run our own support this way, and we've written down exactly how.

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Support answers live in five tools and the product itself. Strawberry checks them all.

items: It uses your helpdesk, billing, and CRM while you're logged in.
It can open the product and reproduce what the customer sees.
It works across many tabs at once, so answers come quickly.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Update the help center from cases that keep coming back.
Review one account's health: usage, open issues, and renewal risk.
Escalate an issue to the right owner with the evidence they need.

blocks.text: Support knowledge usually lives in the heads of the two people who've been there longest. Save it as team skills and every companion answers the way they would.
Put queue triage on a Routine and every shift starts with the cases sorted and the next steps drafted.
